Ask a question: how are you currently tracking who gave what — and what's the weakest link in that system?
No pitch. Close by saying: tomorrow I'll share the one protocol that actually holds under real-life pressure.
sequence.cta: Reply and tell me your system

subject_lines: Check before you give — not after
One rule. Fewer errors. Here's how.
sequence.preview_text: The 3-step protocol families use to close the coordination gap.
content_summary: The confirm-before-you-give protocol — three steps, no app required.
Why 'after the fact' logging always fails (the window of ambiguity).
Mention that apps like DoseSync are built around this exact protocol — real-time confirmation, visible to all caregivers instantly.
Close: the protocol works with any tool. The tool just determines how fast the confirmation travels.
sequence.ps_line: P.S. The grandparent mode mentioned in the checklist — that idea came directly from families who needed a version simple enough for one-button use.
